text:
Renee (CS): Evergreen dedicated launch scheduled for WED 04:30 UTC. Scope: quota handoff, staged regional ramp (us-west then eu-central), autoscale tuning, one-time billing buffer, and short customer feedback capture 30m after steady-state. Who can own live ops updates and the rollback watch?

Omar (Infra): I can take infra handoff + reservation. Pool details: pool-id=evergreen-ded-02, template=reserved-a100v4-flexmem, slots=9, spare=2. Ill create reservation and attach manifest.

Hannah (SE): Ill lead staged load + quality checks. Plan: warmup 10m -> canary 10m at 10% -> ramp 40% for 20m -> full traffic. Need canary API key and KMS unseal 04:15-04:35 UTC. Will post perf snapshots every 5m and a short prompt-set for quality review.

Felix (SRE): Autoscale baseline: min_replicas=3, target_util=62%, max_replicas=16, scale_up_cooldown=100s, scale_down_cooldown=300s. Add secondary signal queue_length with threshold 1400. Set p95 alert at 340ms. Recommend circuit-breaker: if error_rate > 1% for >2m, shift 25% to hosted fallback and pause ramp.

Renee (CS): Customer requested a one-off warmup credit and a 30m feedback call after go-live. Ill log the renewal note (health=neutral) and collect NPS items. Also need someone to post short customer-facing status blurbs during the 04:30-05:30 window.

Omar (Infra): Reservation + warmup commands:

Omar (Infra): ```
# reserve and prime caches/KV
redwoodctl reserve create --pool evergreen-ded-02 --slots 9 --duration 5h --note "evergreen-launch-RES-7782"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool evergreen-ded-02 --profile cache-and-kv --concurrency 6
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled load job id=6288881234-load by @Hannah for 2026-09-09T04:35:00Z. Load logs will post to this thread.

Hannah (SE): Smoke curl (token redacted at runtime):

Hannah (SE): ```
curl -sS -X POST https://evergreen.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer CANARY_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"smoke test"}'
```

Felix (SRE): Fallback variants prepared: hosted-quantized-lite and hosted-quantized-v2. Routing policy: region=us-west -> fallback=hosted-quantized-v2 with max-fallback-rate=25% for first 2h. If p95 > 400ms or errors > 1% sustained -> execute traffic-shift script. Ill post 5-min metric snapshots (p50/p95/error_rate/queue_len).

Renee (CS): Also, please capture token burn ledger and flag any unexpected billing spikes to finance. Ill request the one-off credit in the billing system (note: customer expects leniency for warmup).

Omar (Infra): Alerts created: quota-evergreen@80% -> #customer-success, #eng-oncall; latency_p95@340ms -> #eng-sre. Added runbook link and rollback snippet to RES-7782.

Hannah (SE): Post-run deliverables: short perf summary (p50/p95/error_rate/token_burn), sample prompt set we used for QA, and a feedback form link for the customer (3 quick questions). Ill upload within 30m of steady-state.

Felix (SRE): Pre-run quick-checklist: 1) KMS unseal window confirmed (Omar) 2) Canary key issued (Hannah) 3) Reservation created (Omar) 4) Runbook + rollback snippet present (Felix) 5) Billing buffer requested (Renee). If any step fails DM me and well hold cutover.

Renee (CS): Thanks all :thumbsup: Ill draft the customer-facing status blurb and post near-real-time updates. If we hit an issue, customer comms owner will notify and schedule the 30m feedback call.
